high_level_description: This underwater photograph captures a serene and magical scene. The setting is a clear blue ocean with sunlight filtering through the water, creating a bright, almost ethereal glow at the surface. The sandy ocean floor is visible beneath the subjects, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. In the foreground, two individuals are positioned in a way that suggests they are mimicking mermaids. One person is lying on their back on the ocean floor, wearing a blue patterned swimsuit and a snorkel mask, while the other is floating above them, also in a swimsuit and wearing flippers.
